title: Deliveries that arrive twice
description:
Handle the same webhook event only once, even when it is delivered again.

```
evt_1 order.paid -> handled
evt_2 order.paid -> handled
evt_1 order.paid -> already handled, skipped
evt_3 refund     -> no handler, acknowledged
```
hints: Check `event["id"] in handled` first; add the id only after the handler finished without an error (lesson 4.03).
Return 500 when the handler fails, so the sender delivers it again later.
requirements: Keep the ids of handled events (a set, or a small file).
Answer every delivery with "200" quickly, even when it is skipped, so the sender stops retrying.
An event that raises inside its handler is not marked as handled.
stretch: Limit the set to the last 10,000 ids with a `collections.deque` beside it.
